programmes.funder: Фонд за иновациону делатност (Innovation Fund Serbia)
programmes.amount_note: Up to RSD 800,000 per innovation voucher, i.e. 60% of the service cost excluding VAT; one applicant may receive several vouchers up to a total of RSD 2,400,000.
programmes.deadline_note: Innovation Vouchers public call is shown as Closed on the Innovation Fund page. Separate AI Voucher Scheme (RSD 600,000-3,600,000) is open until 31 March 2027 but new applications suspended from 10 September 2026.
programmes.source_snippet: up to RSD 800,000 per individual innovation voucher, ie. 60% of the total cost of the service, excluding value-added tax (VAT)

programmes.funder: Фонд за иновациону делатност (Innovation Fund Serbia)
programmes.amount_note: Up to EUR 500,000, or up to 70% of the approved project budget for micro and small enterprises (60% for medium enterprises); applicant provides minimum 30% (40% for medium). Projects up to 18 months.
programmes.deadline_note: Public call shown as Closed on the Innovation Fund programme page.
programmes.reopen_note: Repeated public calls; check inovacionifond.rs for the current window.
programmes.source_snippet: up to EUR 500,000, or up to 70% of the total approved project budget for micro and small enterprises, or 60% for medium enterprises

programmes.funder: Фонд за иновациону делатност (Innovation Fund Serbia)
programmes.amount_note: Up to EUR 120,000, or up to 70% of the approved project budget; applicant provides at least 30% from private sources. Projects up to 12 months.
programmes.deadline_note: Public call shown as Closed on the Innovation Fund Mini Grants page.
programmes.reopen_note: The Innovation Fund has run repeated public calls (javni pozivi) for the Mini Grants programme; monitor inovacionifond.rs for the open call.
programmes.source_snippet: up to EUR 120,000, or up to 70% of the total approved project budget
